about.title: Welcome to Vogueritual
about.intro: At Vogueritual, we believe online shopping should provide convenience, variety, and clear information.
about.body: We are a US-based multi-category online retailer offering products across different areas of everyday life, including electronics, home improvement, outdoor living, lawn and garden, power equipment, fireplaces, and wellness. Our goal is to bring a wide selection of products together in one convenient shopping destination.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Vogueritual operates through our official website: https://vogueritual.us.
Our business is located in Stockton, California, and serves customers throughout the United States.
We aim to help customers explore products, compare available options, and make informed purchasing decisions.

sections.title: What we offer
paragraphs: Our store features a broad selection of product categories. Our catalog may expand as new products become available.
bullets: Electronics & Entertainment: Gaming consoles, TVs, computer monitors, and related electronics.
Lawn & Garden: Awnings, gazebos, pergolas, greenhouses, porch swings, and other outdoor essentials.
Outdoor Power Equipment: Chainsaws, pressure washers, lawn maintenance equipment, leaf blowers, snow blowers, and more.
Fireplaces & Heating: Fireplaces, wood stoves, fireplace screens, hearth pads, and log storage solutions.
Saunas & Home Improvement: Saunas, medicine cabinets, and related home products.

sections.title: Our mission
paragraphs: Our mission is to make everyday shopping simpler by bringing useful products from different categories together on one platform.
We aim to support customers with clear product information, transparent policies, and convenient shipping.

sections.title: Our vision
paragraphs: We aim to make Vogueritual a convenient destination for customers seeking products for their homes, entertainment, outdoor activities, and daily needs.

commitment.title: Your shopping experience matters
commitment.intro: At Vogueritual, we are committed to making online shopping more convenient through product variety, straightforward information, and transparent customer policies.
commitment.body: Our commitments guide how we present products, fulfill orders, and support our customers.

sections.title: 1. Clear product information
paragraphs: We aim to provide useful product descriptions, specifications, images, and other relevant details.
Customers should be able to review essential information before making a purchasing decision.

sections.title: 2. Transparent pricing
paragraphs: We display product prices in United States dollars.
Applicable taxes are calculated or displayed during checkout where required.
We provide free standard shipping throughout the United States.

sections.title: 3. Shipping transparency
paragraphs: Our published shipping estimates include the items below. Delivery times are estimates and may be affected by unforeseen circumstances.

sections.title: 4. Customer-friendly returns
paragraphs: We accept eligible returns for defective and non-defective products within 30 days.
Approved returns qualify for free return shipping, and no restocking fees apply.
Eligible exchanges are also accepted.

sections.title: 5. Customer support
paragraphs: Our team can assist with the requests below.

sections.title: 6. Responsible information handling
paragraphs: We recognize the importance of protecting customer information.
We aim to use appropriate safeguards and provide privacy information through our website policies.

sections.title: 7. Honest communication
paragraphs: We aim to communicate product availability, applicable shipping estimates, and policy requirements clearly.
If an order cannot be fulfilled as expected, we will review the available options and applicable customer rights.

sections.title: 8. Continuous improvement
paragraphs: We value customer feedback and aim to improve our shopping experience, product information, and support processes.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers about Vogueritual orders, shipping, returns, and products. Our official website is https://vogueritual.us.

items.question: What is Vogueritual?
items.answer: Vogueritual is a multi-category online store offering products across electronics, home improvement, lawn and garden, fireplaces, outdoor power equipment, wellness, and other categories.

items.question: What is your official website?
items.answer: Our official website is https://vogueritual.us.

items.question: Where is Vogueritual located?
items.answer: Our business address is 2260 Porter Way, Stockton, CA 95207, United States.

items.question: How can I contact customer service?
items.answer: Email info@vogueritual.us or call +1 (209) 810-5789.

items.question: What products do you sell?
items.answer: Our categories include gaming and electronics, outdoor living products, lawn equipment, fireplaces, wood stoves, saunas, and home improvement products. Availability varies by product.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Browse our store, choose your products, add them to your cart, and complete checkout.

items.question: What currency do you use?
items.answer: Prices and transactions are processed in US dollars.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Available payment methods are displayed during checkout.

items.question: Can I cancel an order?
items.answer: Contact customer support as soon as possible. Cancellation depends on the order's fulfillment status.

items.question: Can I change my shipping address?
items.answer: Contact us immediately. Address changes cannot be made after an order has been dispatched under our published shipping policy.

items.question: Do you offer free shipping?
items.answer: Yes. Standard shipping is free throughout the United States.

items.question: Is there a minimum purchase for free shipping?
items.answer: No. All orders qualify for free standard shipping.

items.question: How long does order processing take?
items.answer: Handling takes approximately 1–3 business days.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Transit is estimated at 3–5 business days.

items.question: What is the total estimated delivery time?
items.answer: 4–8 business days, including handling and transit.

items.question: What is your daily order cutoff?
items.answer: 5:00 PM PST.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: No. We currently ship only within the United States.

items.question: Can you ship to PO Boxes?
items.answer: Yes. We accept PO Box deliveries through supported postal services.

items.question: Do you ship to APO/FPO military addresses?
items.answer: Yes. Eligible APO/FPO addresses are accepted through supported postal services.

items.question: Will I receive tracking information?
items.answer: Yes. Your shipping confirmation includes tracking information once the shipment has been collected and scanned by the carrier.

items.question: When does tracking update?
items.answer: Tracking information usually updates within 24–48 hours.

items.question: What is your return window?
items.answer: 30 days.

items.question: Do you accept returns for defective products?
items.answer: Yes.

items.question: Can I return a product if I change my mind?
items.answer: Yes, provided it meets the eligibility requirements for non-defective returns.

items.question: What condition must a return be in?
items.answer: Standard non-defective returns must be in new condition.

items.question: Are exchanges available?
items.answer: Yes. Eligible exchanges are accepted.

items.question: Is return shipping free?
items.answer: Yes. Our published policy provides a free return label included in the package.

items.question: Do you charge restocking fees?
items.answer: No. Our restocking fee is $0.00.

items.question: How long do refunds take?
items.answer: Our published refund processing time is 10 days.

items.question: What if my order arrives damaged?
items.answer: Contact us promptly, preferably within 48 hours, and provide photographs where available.

items.question: What if my package is missing?
items.answer: Check the delivery area and contact customer support so we can review available tracking and carrier information.

items.question: Do all products have a warranty?
items.answer: Warranty coverage depends on the product and any applicable manufacturer warranty.

items.question: Can I ask about product compatibility?
items.answer: Yes. Contact us with the product model and relevant requirements.

items.question: Do you offer product installation?
items.answer: Installation is not included unless explicitly stated in a product listing or order agreement.
